title: Fair Infinitesimal Jackknife: Mitigating the Influence of Biased Training Data Points Without Refitting

bias_targets.methodology: Measured using Demographic Parity (DP) and Equality of Opportunity (EQOPP) differences across gender groups on the Adult income prediction dataset.
Evaluated by computing Demographic Parity (DP) and Equality of Odds (EO) differences between racial groups (White and Black) on the ACSPublicCoverage health insurance prediction dataset.

Assessed by measuring differences in Demographic Parity (DP) and Equality of Odds (EO) for text comments annotated with the 'Muslim' sensitive attribute in the CivilComments toxicity classification dataset.
